notes.title: Steam Controller Support
notes.content:
Hello all Minimalists,

[b]First patch[/b] is out with [b]complete support for Steam Controller[/b]. From today you can play [b]Minimal[/b] from couch on your big TV! We are listening to all the feedback you guys are posting/writing/messaging/emailing and we are working hard to bring more exciting updates! Stay tuned...

Thank you for your support ːsteamhappyː and MARRY CHRISTMAS ːsteamhappyː
